trap.label: resposta curta
trap.wrong: Do I have to? Yes, you must.
trap.right: Do I have to? Yes, you do.
trap.why: Depois de uma pergunta com have to, responda com do/don’t. Must e don’t have to não são opostos: mustn’t é proibição.

opts: You don’t have to smoke here.

fix.right: You don’t have to pay; it’s free.

fix.wrong: Do I have to go? Yes, I do have.
fix.right: Do I have to go? Yes, you do.

fix.wrong: You don’t have to enter; it’s dangerous.
